package controls
func ReceiveLoop(ch chan int) int { out:=0; for i:=0;i<2;i++ { select { case v:=<-ch: if v<5 { v=5 };out+=v } };return out }

package controls
func AssignExisting(ch chan int) int { v:=0; for i:=0;i<2;i++ { select { case v=<-ch: if v<5 { v=5 } } };return v }

package controls
func TwoValue(ch chan int) bool { select { case v,ok:=<-ch: _=v;return ok };return false }

package controls
func ShadowOuter(ch chan int) int { v:=7;select { case v:=<-ch:_=v;default: };return v }

package controls
func SendOnly(ch chan int) { v:=7;select { case ch<-v:default: } }

package controls
func DefaultOnly() int { v:=7;select { default:v=9 };return v }

package controls
func TwoCases(a,b chan int) int { select { case x:=<-a:return x;case y:=<-b:return y } }

package controls
func Closure(ch chan int) { f:=func(){ select { case x:=<-ch:_=x } };_=f }
